question: Which of the following symbols is a correct representation for air mass above a hot and dry desert region?
solution:
The correct answer is **__cT__. ****
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• cT** symbol is used to represent** air mass above hot and dry desert regions.** 
 
• **Hot dry international tropical( cT) **air forms over **hot desertlike international disciplines** in **summer** in association with **low-pressure areas**, which are occasionally called **heat lows.** 
 
• **Continental tropical( cT)** air millions are** hot, dry, unstable at low situations** and generally stable above( upper- position crest) **Continental tropical air millions appear in northern Mexico. **
 
• They generally form over the **Desert Southwest and northern Mexico during summer. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An air mass** is like a platoon whose players are all wearing the same livery. In this case, the players are air, not people. **
 
• **The border between two air masses at the Earth’s face is called rainfall front. **
 
• 
 
 
 

 cA
 Found in Northern Canada, Alaska as a result of radiational cooling.
 
 

 cP
 cP is used to refer to Continental Polar region.
 
 

 cT
 cT is used to refer to the continental tropical region.
 
 

 mP
 mPis used to refer to the maritime polar region. usually occurs in Southweswar countries and Northeast countries.
